newsitem.title: USA: Ithaca Industries completes bankruptcy proceedings.
newsitem.headline: Ithaca Industries completes bankruptcy proceedings.

text.p: Ithaca Industries Inc said it emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy and as a result has 50 percent less debt that it did when it filed for bankruptcy on October 8.

The company's reorganization plan, approved by the Delaware Bankruptcy Court on November 22, gives holders of the company's 11.125 senior subordinated notes 100 percent of the company's outstanding common stock.

The company said that during the bankruptcy it also made "significant operational improvements" that have slashed operating costs. It did not give details, and company officials were not immediately available to comment.
